p.s: The importance of try new things must not be underated.
The reserch of new things is the most important explanation for many characteristics of people.
I must say, concerning this, that the great increase in number of new things and uncontrolled development of new subject and new field has not helped the person.
Modern techiniques, present philosophy of life and the way of thinking have reduced the simple things to obstacle for development of personality and intelligence of a person.
But this way of thinking is very ancient; it goes back to latins and to etrurians.
Unfortunately the stress of reserch always new activity consumes the people; relax of people run serious risks because modern man.
Work and new activity remains an important factors; they are a things that serves not only, for earning honestly money, but they also give another meaning to existence.
This is dignifild and respected activity.
But this way of thinking is not always a pleasure, but it is a duty.
This because the work is not done with passion, but for acquire more power.
I believe that when an activity is well chosen and liked, it becomes an important factor for development of personality of a person.
But, between people and people 's dreams there has always been a sort of war.
This because, an example, since work is done by machine, this mens that the man works less; but this also means that unemployment increase.
When a society becomes industrialized and tecnological, the work it produces no longer needs man.
In fact where a machine is installed, a man is dismissed.
I believe that today who seek always new things form an important part of society.
The reserch of new way of do, means joy, happiness and true affection towards the world.
Giving to world, without expected anything in return, means seek new tecnology and new way of thinking.
Above all, marking people understand, that live without discovery is uselessness.
To eliminate sadness of world seems really impossible.
In fact in the life of man anything is only a pleasure.
